title: Sandbox samples handoff + quickstarts check-in (Sep 13 2026)
content:
Context:
This doc captures the handoff conversation from the Samples & Quickstarts squad to Platform Onboarding (PO) and the Console docs owners. Goal: make the new sandbox-based SDK examples the canonical quickstarts for Hosted API and Dedicated. Notes are rough — things to action, decisions, and follow-ups listed below.

Meeting details:
- Date: 2026-09-13 10:00 PDT
- Attendees: Samira (owner), Miguel, Jin, Priya, Oliver, Cassie (PO), Marco (Console docs)
- Duration: 45m

High-level summary:
- We validated the new sandbox workflow for JS/py SDK quickstarts. Sandbox now pre-seeds a small model config and a demo dataset that exercises streaming + function-calls.
- The team agreed to retire the old gist-based quickstarts once the console-hosted tour is live (target: Oct 04).
- We identified three immediate blockers that prevent us from promoting the examples to public docs.

Decisions made:
1) Adopt sandbox as default environment for quickstarts. Rationale: reproducible, shorter setup, covers common surface (streaming + tool-calls).
2) Keep one minimal gist-style example for advanced users (auth-only), but mark as "advanced/legacy" in docs.
3) Merge SDK sample PRs in two batches: core examples (JS + Python minimal flows) by Sep 20; extended examples (tooling, embeddings, reranking) by Oct 01.

Blockers (actionable):
- B1: Sandbox env URL rotates daily in staging; onboarding script fails for some regions. Action: Miguel to add region-stable redirect by 2026-09-17. (Jira: DEVEXP-321)
- B2: Function-call schema examples are using an older JSON schema that Console linter rejects. Action: Jin to update schema + add unit to sample generator by 2026-09-16. (PR: github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/458)
- B3: CI for samples doesn't run the streaming integration tests in dedicated mode. Action: Priya to add dedicated-mode test runner and a small token fixture by 2026-09-22.

Action items (owners / ETA):
- Samira: Draft public-facing "migration note" for devblog and docs site by Sep 24. Include upgrade path from gist -> sandbox.
- Miguel: Implement stable sandbox redirect; update README links; block resolution due Sep 17.
- Jin: Update function-call schema in samples generator; add lint hook; due Sep 16.
- Priya: Add CI job for dedicated-mode streaming tests + fixture; due Sep 22.
- Oliver: Review and approve PR batch 1 (core examples) by Sep 19.
- Cassie (PO): Coordinate console tour schedule and ensure product tour covers "run sample in sandbox" flow; target Oct 04.
- Marco (Console docs): Reserve a doc slot in the Console docs nav and prepare screenshots after PR merge; due Oct 02.

Quick checklist for PR batch 1 (minimal examples):
- [ ] README with 3-step run instructions (install, authenticate, run)
- [ ] One-liner auth example for Hosted API + Dedicated notes in a single file
- [ ] Streaming example that prints tokens as they arrive (JS and py)
- [ ] Small function-call example with validated schema (Jin to update)
- [ ] Test: smoke run against sandbox in CI (Priya)

Quality notes / gotchas observed during walkthrough:
- The sandbox bundle includes a small 100-token model config which sometimes times out on long streaming tests; lowered test payloads to 50 tokens for CI.
- Users hitting the sandbox for the first time get a popup re: telemetry; need copy approved by Privacy. Cassie to follow up with Security & Privacy.
- The sample generator outputs a code snippet with an absolute path to local fixtures on macOS; switch to relative paths to avoid confusion.

Follow-ups and comms plan:
- Internal announcement (ENG all) after PR batch 1 merges. Samira to draft and circulate.
- Devblog post: "How we built reproducible quickstarts with sandbox" — target publish Oct 12 (depends on Console tour).
- Update Quickstarts Playbook in Confluence with new checklist and repo links (owner: Samira).

Open questions (unresolved):
- Q1: Should we include a short video walkthrough embedded in Console docs, or link to a hosted Loom? (Cassie to propose by Sep 20)
- Q2: What telemetry do we surface for quickstart runs in Sandbox? (Security & Privacy must sign off)
- Q3: Do we expose a one-click "run in sandbox" button in the docs site or keep the Console tour as the canonical path? (PO to decide)

Notes to self / rough ideas:
- Consider a "sample lint" GH action that flags deprecated API usage across repos. Low effort but high ROI.
- Potential small hackathon to let product folks author short guided samples (2 days). Good internal engagement.
- Move the legacy gist examples into an archive/legacy folder and add a redirect from old doc URLs.

Relevant links and references:
- PRs: github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/458 (schema updates), github.com/redwood-inference/sdks/pull/462 (streaming example)
- Confluence: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DEV/Quickstarts+Playbook
- Jira: DEVEXP-321, DEVEXP-322, DEVEXP-330

Next check-in:
- Weekly sync slot: Tue 09/21 10:00 PDT to validate PR merges and CI green.

End of notes.

-- Samira

(Quick informal edit log)
- 2026-09-13 initial notes (meeting)
- 2026-09-14 added action items, PR links, assigned owners
- 2026-09-15 updated blockers and CI ETA after follow-up with Priya
